1d955be6d44b1623.description: We are seeking a qualified Specialist or Consultant in Infectious Diseases to join a reputable healthcare facility in the UAE. The successful candidate will diagnose, treat, and manage a broad range of infectious diseases, including complex infections, antimicrobial-resistant organisms, and emerging infectious conditions, while ensuring compliance with international clinical standards and UAE healthcare regulations. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive clinical assessments and diagnose infectious diseases caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites. Manage complex infections, including sepsis, bloodstream infections, pneumonia, meningitis, tuberculosis, HIV, and other communicable diseases. Evaluate and treat infections in immunocompromised patients, including those undergoing cancer treatment or organ transplantation. Develop individualized treatment plans and prescribe appropriate antimicrobial, antiviral, antifungal, and antiparasitic therapies. Provide expert guidance on antimicrobial stewardship, appropriate antibiotic use, resistance prevention, and treatment optimization. Interpret laboratory investigations, microbiology cultures, antimicrobial susceptibility results, molecular diagnostic tests, and relevant imaging. Assess and manage hospital-acquired infections, healthcare-associated complications, and infections involving multiple organ systems. Collaborate with microbiologists, intensivists, surgeons, haematologists, oncologists, and other specialists to coordinate multidisciplinary patient care. Support infection prevention and control programmes, outbreak investigations, and communicable disease management in accordance with applicable UAE public health requirements. Provide consultation on complex infections, including those involving prosthetic devices, surgical sites, and vascular catheters. Recognized medical degree (MBBS or equivalent). Recognized postgraduate specialist qualification in Infectious Diseases or an accepted equivalent specialty pathway. International qualifications may include: Relevant post-qualification experience as required by the applicable UAE licensing authority. Eligibility for Specialist or Consultant classification under DHA, DOH, or MOHAP, subject to credential assessment and applicable Professional Qualification Requirements (PQR). Valid professional registration and Good Standing Certificate, where applicable. Strong clinical judgment, communication, and multidisciplinary collaboration skills. Competitive salary package based on qualifications and experience. Employment visa and medical insurance, subject to applicable regulations and employer policy. Annual paid leave and end-of-service benefits in accordance with UAE labour law. Annual air ticket or travel allowance, depending on employer policy. Relocation assistance, where offered by the employer. Opportunities to work in modern healthcare facilities with multidisciplinary teams. Support with UAE healthcare licensing and recruitment, where applicable.

1d28098c5c8db46b.description: Job description About the job E&I DESIGNER (CS) We are seeking an experienced E lectrical & Instrumentation (E&I) Designer (Construction Support – CS) for marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing design and technical support to shipyard production teams, resolving electrical and instrumentation-related design issues, updating production drawings, and ensuring design accuracy, constructability, and compliance with project specifications and applicable marine standards. Prepare, review, and revise E&I design deliverables, including: Electrical equipment layout and arrangement drawings Cable routing, cable tray, and cable ladder layouts Cable schedules, cable termination drawings, and interconnection diagrams Lighting and small power layouts Electrical installation and equipment connection drawings Instrument location and installation drawings Instrument cable routing and hook-up drawings Junction box layouts, termination diagrams, and instrument wiring drawings Earthing and bonding layout drawings Electrical and instrumentation equipment installation details Production, fabrication, and installation drawings 2D drawings and 3D models for E&I systems Review shop drawings and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve E&I design-related issues. Provide technical support to shipyard production teams for electrical and instrumentation installation, assembly, and construction activities. Resolve technical queries (TQs), drawing discrepancies, cable routing conflicts, and installation-related design problems. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into drawings, cable schedules, and 3D models. Coordinate with Hull Structure, Hull Outfitting, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines to ensure proper integration and avoid design clashes. Verify cable routing, equipment locations, installation clearances, and interfaces with marine equipment and structural arrangements. Review vendor drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation to ensure compatibility with project design requirements. Ensure E&I design deliverables comply with project specifications, applicable marine standards, classification requirements, and shipyard construction practices. Support constructability reviews and identify potential installation constraints before execution. Maintain updated production drawings, cable schedules, design records, and technical documentation in accordance with project procedures. Coordinate with engineering teams, equipment vendors, and production personnel to ensure timely resolution of design issues. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final production modifications, where required. Ensure design deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. KEY QUALIFICATIONS: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline. 5–10 years of relevant experience in Electrical & Instrumentation design within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, offshore vessel, or related offshore engineering projects. Hands-on experience in Construction Support (CS), shipyard production support, and production drawing modifications. Strong experience in electrical and instrumentation layouts, cable routing, equipment installation, and associated production drawings. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other shipbuilding CAD software accepted by the client. Experience preparing and modifying 2D production drawings, 3D models, cable routing layouts, termination drawings, and installation details. Good understanding of marine electrical systems, instrumentation installation, cable trays, cable glands, junction boxes, earthing, and bonding arrangements. Ability to interpret electrical and instrumentation drawings, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, equipment specifications, vendor documentation, and production mark-ups. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during electrical and instrumentation installation activities. Familiarity with marine electrical standards, applicable IEC requirements, classification society rules, and project specifications. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, Hull Outfitting, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Strong technical problem-solving, drawing interpretation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment. VERTICAL ENGINEERING Preferred candidate Years of experience 2+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

1dea60268e4da2ff.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a HSE Lead (Saudi National) for a full-time position in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. The HSE Lead will ensure that Contractors deliver work safely and in compliance with contractual HSE requirements, project HSE standards, and Saudi regulations. Key Responsibilities The successful candidate will oversee Contractor HSE performance across pipeline corridors, pump stations, and associated works. This includes driving a strong safety culture and supporting zero harm through effective risk management, assurance, incident management, and continuous improvement. Review and approve Contractor HSE deliverables, such as HSE Plans, Environmental Management Plans, risk assessments, method statements, emergency response plans, and traffic management plans. Oversee control of high-risk pipeline activities, including deep excavations, trenching, lifting operations, pipe handling, confined space entry, hot work, hydrotesting, working near live utilities, and energization. Monitor implementation of the permit-to-work system, safe systems of work, and critical risk controls across pipeline corridors, pump stations, and reservoir sites. Plan and conduct HSE inspections, audits, and site walks, tracking findings and corrective actions through to close-out. Lead or support incident reporting and investigation, root cause analysis, and the sharing of lessons learned. Oversee road and driving safety across long linear pipeline corridors, including journey management, fatigue management, defensive driving, and logistics traffic controls. Ensure environmental controls are implemented, covering waste management, dust, noise, spill prevention, water discharge from hydrotesting, and protection of sensitive habitats. Oversee worker welfare, heat stress management, and emergency response arrangements for remote linear sites, including drills and medical evacuation. Prepare HSE performance reports and KPIs (leading and lagging), and present HSE performance and risks to project leadership. Promote a positive safety culture through leadership engagement, HSE campaigns, toolbox talks, training, and recognition. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant HSE role. Must be a Saudi National. The project leverages Cloudera CDP **, Medallion, and Lambda (batch, streaming, and serving) architectures. Role Context and Objectives The Insights & Data practice assists organizations in leveraging data to drive innovation, efficiency, and transformation, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Agentic AI technologies. The Business Analyst will work across retail and corporate banking domains, ensuring alignment with SAMA regulatory and compliance standards. Key objectives include facilitating knowledge transfer, conducting stakeholder interviews, defining acceptance criteria, and supporting testing activities. Key Responsibilities Lead knowledge transfer sessions and stakeholder interviews across banking, risk, compliance, and operations teams. Gather, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements. Prepare Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), data contracts, and source-to-target mappings. Translate requirements into user stories with clear acceptance criteria and traceability. Manage and prioritize the product backlog while controlling scope changes. Ensure alignment with Medallion, Lambda, and data governance frameworks. Provide expertise across retail and corporate banking domains. Ensure compliance with SAMA regulations, data governance, and audit requirements. Collaborate with architects, data modelers, and development teams to align business and technical needs. Facilitate workshops, drive decisions, and manage stakeholder expectations. Support test planning, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) execution, and acceptance validation. Perform data validation and reconciliation using SQL. Participate in Agile ceremonies and maintain Jira/Confluence artifacts. Communicate project status, risks, and key updates to stakeholders. Required Skills and Attributes Strong stakeholder management skills. Effective communication abilities. Proven analytical skills. Experience with data lakehouse implementations on Cloudera CDP *** Familiarity with Medallion and Lambda architectures (batch, streaming, serving). Knowledge of retail and corporate banking domains. Understanding of SAMA regulatory and compliance standards. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and involves working within Capgemini's Insights & Data practice. The position requires collaboration with various internal and client teams, including banking, risk, compliance, operations, architecture, data modeling, and development teams. About Capgemini Capgemini is a company that focuses on leveraging technology to transform businesses. Joining Capgemini offers opportunities to collaborate with industry experts and contribute to client innovation and business growth.

1ddfe853499db18a.description: About the Role National Medical Care is seeking a Dental Assistant to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. The Dental Assistant will be responsible for supporting dentists during various diagnostic, operative, surgical, periodontal, preventive, orthodontic, prosthodontic, endodontic, or pedodontic procedures, ensuring high-quality patient care. Key Responsibilities Prepare and dismiss patients, providing post-operative instructions as prescribed by the Dentist. Perform point-of-use cleaning of instrumentation and disinfect equipment. Maintain supply order and applicable records. Assist the designated Dentist and provide oral hygiene prophylaxis. Support the Dentist during conscious sedation procedures within the clinic. Assist in operation room sessions as part of professional development. Perform oral prophylaxis and provide oral hygiene instructions to patients. Provide chairside assistance to Dentists. Ensure maintenance of materials, equipment, and cleanliness within the dental area. Perform cleaning, washing, packing, and sterilization of instruments to prevent cross-infection, adhering to department policy. Maintain and periodically review skills in First Aid and Cardio-Pulmonary Resuscitation; handle medical emergencies until the Dentist arrives or assist the Dentist in rendering emergency first aid. Accurately chart patient oral conditions as reported by the doctor and record treatment rendered in the patient’s permanent chart. Coordinate with reception and encoders for charges, appointment scheduling, and necessary paperwork. Participate in ongoing monthly education developed by the department. Help maintain dental surgery equipment. Abide by department policies and procedures, by-laws, rules, and regulations of the hospital. Educate patients and families according to their needs and implement the patient and family education process, including documentation in medical records. Comply with the hospital dress code. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the scope of knowledge, skills, and abilities. Reporting Structure The Dental Assistant will report directly to an Assigned Dentist and does not have any supervisory responsibilities. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a dental assistant role. Knowledgeable about essential roles in patient and family education. Proficiency in performing clinical functions such as preparing patients, cleaning instruments, and providing post-operative instructions. Ability to maintain supply order and accurate records. Skills in oral prophylaxis and providing oral hygiene instructions. Competence in instrument sterilization and cross-infection prevention. Current knowledge and skills in First Aid and Cardio-Pulmonary Resuscitation. Strong charting and record-keeping abilities. Effective coordination skills for appointments and administrative tasks. Work Environment This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the National Medical Care facility. The Dental Assistant will work closely with dentists and other medical staff to ensure a superior quality of medical treatment and compassionate care for every patient.

1dc2e75e5f6418e5.description: ASMO is a groundbreaking joint venture between DHL and Aramco. Inheriting DHL’s logistics excellence and Aramco’s extensive supply chain ecosystem, we are here to set a new benchmark and redefine the procurement and supply chain landscape, enabling growth. ASMO aims to be operational in 2025 and provide reliable end-to-end integrated procurement and supply chain services for companies across the industrial, energy, chemical, and petrochemical sectors. Our focus customers in the short term will be Saudi Aramco and its Affiliates. In the long term, all the industrial sectors within Saudi Arabia aim to reach the MENA region. Objective The Operational Excellence Analyst is responsible for supporting the Support Functions Manager in IT Solutions-related activities in the Operational Excellence Department. The Analyst will help bridge the gap between business requirements and technology solutions by working closely with stakeholders from Operational Excellence. General Responsibilities The role holder will have knowledge of the rules, procedures and in some cases, the principles and practices within the IT Solutions discipline for the Operational Excellence area. They will be tasked with selectively extracting, verifying, and compiling objective and measurable data. In some instances, they may determine the course of action based on established principles and modify existing processes and methods. Help identify operational needs and requirements related to IT solutions used in Operational Excellence/finance and HR ; work with the Support Functions Manager to implement plans and strategies for addressing these needs using IT solutions. Assess current processes, identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies, and propose and implement solutions to enhance operational efficiency; may use methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma or other process improvement frameworks. Follow system requirements set by the Support Functions Manager, evaluate software options, help manage vendor relationships, and ensure that solutions are in line with the IT Solutions department’s objectives and align with ASMO’s business goals. Contribute to the Support Functions unit’s projects in collaboration with the IT Business Relationship Manager for Support Functions, conduct risk assessments of these projects, ensure timely delivery, and suggest improvements to implementation processes. Review functional/technical design document for Finance and HR applications Review and manage all changes to the requirements through a formally defined change request procedure Configure the application based on functional specification Ensure that developed solutions are reviewed and formally documented. Recommend training and development interventions for team members to build their capabilities. Contribute to the identification of opportunities for the continuous improvement of systems, processes and practices to increase productivity and operational efficiency. Implement all relevant IT Solutions department’s policies, processes, procedures and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Contribute to the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet departmental requirements, policies and standards. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in operations management, information technology, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required. Master’s degree in operations management, information technology or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is preferred Any operations software-related/other relevant certification preferred (i.e. Six Sigma) Demonstrated proficiency in oral and written English. 5 years’ experience in the same Field. Deadline is one month from posting.

1d1521ebfa6f10c1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أمار المتحدة عن أخصائي تطوير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة الممارسات الدولية في التطوير الإداري وتحديد الاحتياجات التطويرية داخل الجهة، بالإضافة إلى اقتراح الخطط والبرامج اللازمة لتحسين الأداء المؤسسي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة التجارب والممارسات الدولية المتخصصة في التطوير الإداري، وتقييم إمكانية وجدوى تطبيقها. تقديم التوصيات والمقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب والممارسات الحديثة في مجال التطوير الإداري. تحليل الأوضاع الإدارية الحالية وتحديد الاحتياجات التطويرية في الجهة المعنية. اقتراح وتطوير الخطط والبرامج اللازمة لعمليات التطوير والتحسين والتميز المؤسسي. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات التطوير الإداري باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة ومواكبة المستجدات في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتطوير الإداري، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض التقارير والوثائق على المعنيين ومناقشتها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بالتطوير الإداري أو الاستشارات. القدرة على البحث وتحليل الممارسات الدولية وتكييفها مع البيئة المحلية. مهارات قوية في إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد الاحتياجات التطويرية. القدرة على اقتراح حلول مبتكرة وفعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لعرض الأفكار ومناقشتها. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق ومواكبة التطورات في المجال. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومقره في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الأخصائي ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق التميز المؤسسي من خلال التطوير الإداري المستمر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

1d41affe7da3adeb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الجبيل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة وصيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تشخيص وحل المشكلات الفنية. تحديد المخطط، وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ التركيب والصيانة الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الهندسة الكهربائية ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل، مع التركيز على تنفيذ المهام الميدانية والفنية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: المنطقة الشرقية، الجبيل الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

The Director will design and convert strategy into activated capability, establishing the operating model, governance framework, service-level agreements with QIC shared services, and the program management discipline necessary for a controlled and rapid company launch. Key Responsibilities Build the corporate strategy, execution priorities, and long-term growth agenda, evaluating emerging healthcare trends aligned with Qiddiya’s vision. Translate approved organizational design into an activated operating model, defining roles, structures, decision rights, interfaces, and ways of working across QHC functions. Manage the enterprise program management office for the startup build, maintaining the master mobilization plan, milestones, dependencies, and critical path. Define and coordinate the shared-services model, leveraging QIC and wider Qiddiya ecosystem shared services (*, finance, human capital, technology) during the startup phase. Own the delivery of the phased transition roadmap for strategy and enterprise activation, including milestones, and coordinate the stand-up of new pillars. Coordinate with Human Capital and function leads on workforce requirements and mobilization dependencies for Day-1 and subsequent activation waves. Establish the enterprise delivery reporting cadence, progress dashboards, and escalation mechanisms to ensure startup delivery alignment. Maintain the enterprise risk and interdependency register for the startup build, driving mitigation and readiness across functions. Serve as the primary coordination point between QHC functions, QIC, and the wider Qiddiya ecosystem on activation and operating-model matters. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of demonstrated experience mobilizing complex, multi-stakeholder programs to defined milestones. Experience ideally within healthcare, sports, government/semi-government, or large ecosystem-based environments. Experience operating within a shared-services or SLA-based model is a strong advantage. Proven ability to translate organizational design and strategy into activated capability, and to manage executive governance and reporting cadences. Working knowledge of the Saudi operating environment and Vision 2030 context is preferred. Work Environment This role operates across every function and the wider Qiddiya ecosystem, ensuring interdependencies are managed and readiness milestones are met. The Director will provide the leadership team with the necessary structures, decisions, and reporting to transition from stabilization to operationalization and institutionalization. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Riyadh.

1d23e6d1411e43f9.description: About the Internship Tabby is seeking a People Operations Intern to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This internship offers hands-on experience supporting the People Operations team in delivering accurate, compliant, and employee-centric HR services. The program is structured as a 3–6 month Co-op / Tamheer training program, designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview In this role, the intern will learn core people operations processes and assist with day-to-day HR transactions under close supervision. The position provides an opportunity to build practical knowledge of Saudi labor regulations and government platforms. The intern will contribute to data integrity, process improvement initiatives, and maintaining a consistent, positive employee experience across the organization. Key Responsibilities Assist in maintaining accurate employee data for KSA employees by processing routine updates under close supervision. Support employee lifecycle transactions, including new hire documentation, employee record updates, and transfers, with guidance from senior team members. Assist with periodic data audits by validating records and flagging discrepancies for review. Help keep HR systems up to date and support data alignment across HR platforms in coordination with the team. Respond to routine employee HR inquiries under guidance, ensuring a professional and service-oriented experience, and escalate questions to senior team members as needed. Support the processing of standard employee requests, including HR letters, salary certificates, leave balance inquiries, and basic employee data updates. Assist in preparing documentation for GOSI registrations, updates, and removals, ensuring completeness and accuracy. Support medical insurance enrollment tasks and help employees with basic queries. Assist in preparing Qiwa contract documentation under guidance. Develop foundational knowledge of KSA people operations requirements and government systems (*, GOSI, Qiwa, Mudad). Support onboarding and offboarding coordination, including documentation, system updates, and clearance steps in line with procedures. Support the preparation of basic reports and data summaries for senior HR team review. Maintain organized and accurate employee records to support audits and internal reviews. This internship offers an opportunity to learn and grow within one of the fastest-growing fintech companies in the region. Devices required for work will be provided.

1d3fb44adbefd65e.description: About Eva Clinics Eva Clinics is a modern medical center in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, specializing in advanced dental care and skin aesthetics. The clinics offer world-class services and distinctive quality, adhering to international standards for both therapeutic and cosmetic treatments. Eva Clinics is known for its competitive pricing and offers, making premium care accessible. The organization currently operates branches in Dammam and Hafar Al-Batin, with an upcoming branch in Khafji, and provides dedicated dermatology promotions at the Dammam location. This role is responsible for overseeing the daily operations and performance of the clinic branch. The Branch Manager ensures efficient patient flow, manages staff, and maintains service quality, coordinating with senior management on operational goals and promotional activities. Key Responsibilities Overseeing daily operations and performance of the clinic branch. Managing staff schedules and supervising front-desk and clinical support teams. Ensuring efficient patient flow throughout the day. Monitoring service quality and implementing company policies. Coordinating with senior management on operational goals, budget adherence, and promotional activities. Handling patient inquiries and escalations. Maintaining facility standards and reviewing operational reports. Supporting local marketing initiatives and community outreach. Focusing on team development, performance feedback, and fostering a professional, patient-centered environment. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience in a similar managerial role. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required. Demonstrated ability to manage daily operations and staff. Strong understanding of service quality and policy implementation. 1d7b4b9ce77a7f52.description: About the Role Haji Husein Alireza & Co. Ltd. is seeking an Accountant to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves preparing, reviewing, and maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring that customer, bank, and supplier accounts are properly recorded and reconciled. The Accountant will also ensure that financial transactions, records, and reports comply with applicable accounting standards, laws, regulations, and company policies. Key Responsibilities Prepare and maintain accounting entries, financial records, and supporting documentation in accordance with accounting standards and company policies. Review invoices, purchase orders, contracts, and related documents for accuracy and completeness. Ensure the correct coding, approval, processing, and filing of financial transactions and obligations. Perform reconciliations for accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank accounts, and general ledger balances. Investigate and resolve discrepancies, errors, and outstanding transactions with appropriate supporting documentation. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities within required timelines. Prepare accounting schedules, reconciliations, and financial reports as requested by management. Maintain records of banking activities, including Letters of Credit, Letters of Guarantee, loans, and credit facilities. Monitor daily cash positions and verify the accuracy of balances and bank transactions. Compile and maintain invoices and supporting documents for tax and audit purposes. Ensure compliance with accounting regulations, tax requirements, and company financial policies. Support inventory count activities and prepare related reports when required. Maintain organized and accurate financial records, files, and supporting documentation. Coordinate with internal departments, suppliers, banks, and auditors to resolve financial and accounting matters. Communicate payment status and critical financial updates to relevant stakeholders. Financial Control and Compliance The role involves monitoring financial transactions to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with internal controls. This includes supporting internal and external audits by providing necessary financial information and documentation, and ensuring the proper retention, confidentiality, and accessibility of accounting and financial documents. Stakeholder Coordination The Accountant will coordinate with banks and internal stakeholders regarding financial transactions and required documentation. This position also provides additional accounting and financial support as assigned by Finance and Accounts Management. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in accounting or a related field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

1df112d307850460.description: About the Role Jobmaze is seeking an experienced AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a highly technical, hands-on, customer-facing role that operates at the intersection of Agentic AI, software engineering, cybersecurity, and enterprise deployment. The successful candidate will work directly with customers and security teams to design, build, integrate, deploy, troubleshoot, and continuously improve production-grade Agentic AI solutions. Key Responsibilities Design and deploy production-grade AI agents and multi-agent workflows. Build Agentic AI solutions using LangChain, LangGraph, and similar frameworks. Develop custom integrations, tools, APIs, workflows, and agent graphs using Python. Integrate AI agents with enterprise cybersecurity platforms and customer infrastructure. Build AI workflows for security alert triage, investigation, threat hunting, incident response, and automation. Troubleshoot AI behavior and improve agent accuracy, reliability, guardrails, and performance. Take solutions from idea to code, integration, deployment, and production. Work directly with enterprise customers, SOC teams, and MSSPs to solve real-world security challenges. Technical Requirements Excellent hands-on Python engineering skills are mandatory. Proven experience building LLM / Agentic AI applications. Strong experience with LangGraph and/or LangChain. Proficiency with REST APIs, WebSockets, FastAPI, Pydantic, and API integrations. Experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, and structured outputs. Understanding of multi-agent architectures, tool/function calling, state, memory, and orchestration. Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI agent infrastructure. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Git, and CI/CD. Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP. Understanding of cybersecurity operations, including SOC, SIEM, EDR/XDR, SOAR, Incident Response, and MITRE ATT&CK. Ability to deploy and troubleshoot solutions in complex enterprise environments. Preferred Experience Experience integrating technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel/Defender, CrowdStrike, Splunk, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Elastic, or OpenSearch will be a strong advantage. We are particularly interested in engineers who have built and deployed real Agentic AI systems, beyond experimentation with prompts or standalone LLM applications. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

1df6418c58b073f2.description: About the Role Majid Al Futtaim is seeking a Store Manager for a supermarket in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 1df9791c598e08db.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Sourcing Specialist to join our team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role involves managing the purchasing process for specific products, ensuring alignment with procurement policies and serving as a key interface between suppliers and internal entities regarding specifications and budgets. 1d9edec5b7da1fad.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إشراقات الصفوة للمقاولات عن سكرتير للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري للمدير أو الإدارة، من خلال تنظيم الوثائق وإدارة الاتصالات وتنسيق المهام اليومية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدوين الملاحظات بطريقة الاختزال (الكتابة السريعة)، ونسخ المراسلات والتقارير ومحاضر الاجتماعات، ومراجعتها وتنسيقها وفقاً لمعايير المكتب. تلقي المكالمات الهاتفية من الموظفين والعملاء الخارجيين، وفرزها وتوجيهها، واستلام الرسائل الهاتفية، والإجابة على أسئلة المتصلين، وتحويل المكالمات إلى الشخص المناسب. التعامل مع البريد الوارد والصادر، وفحص المراسلات البريدية وتسجيلها وتوزيعها. فحص طلبات الاجتماعات والمواعيد، وتنسيق جداول المشاركين، وتحديد أوقات الاجتماعات، وتأمين قاعة الاجتماعات وتحضير جدول الأعمال. إنشاء أنظمة لحفظ الملفات والسجلات وصيانتها، وحفظ جميع المستندات بشكل منتظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال السكرتارية أو الدعم الإداري. القدرة على كتابة الوثائق وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية والزوار بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التدوين والتنسيق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. القدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة وتحديد الأولويات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة في شركة إشراقات الصفوة للمقاولات. سيتم العمل بشكل مباشر لدعم الإدارة في المهام اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

1dd7a289aee6b7c5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ماهر حسن المغامسي للمقاولات العامة عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الأداء الفعال للمنظومات والمعدات الميكانيكية من خلال تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بدقة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح لضمان دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد أسبابها. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة في تقدير التكاليف والمستلزمات. الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية. مهارات إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل في شركة ماهر حسن المغامسي للمقاولات العامة، وتقع في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

1de1c77f65a39881.description: About ACSC ACSC is a Saudi construction company delivering residential, commercial, and multi-storey building projects. We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer to join our Projects Department in Riyadh. Job Purpose The QA/QC Engineer will be responsible for ensuring that all construction works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, technical specifications, contract requirements, Saudi Building Code requirements, and ACSC quality standards. The role will oversee site inspections, material approvals, testing, non-conformance management, quality reporting, and coordination with consultants, clients, subcontractors, and internal project teams to reduce rework and improve project delivery quality. Key Responsibilities Quality Management Implement ACSC’s Quality Management System across assigned projects. Prepare, update, and monitor the Project Quality Plan. Prepare and review Method Statements in coordination with project and technical teams. Prepare, review, and implement Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs). Ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, contracts, and applicable Saudi Building Code requirements. Monitor quality performance and submit regular reports to the Project Department Manager. Site Inspections and Quality Control Conduct daily inspections and quality walkthroughs across assigned project sites. Verify that executed works comply with approved drawings, specifications, approved material submittals, and workmanship standards. Raise, track, and follow up Inspection Requests. Attend inspections with consultants, clients, subcontractors, and relevant stakeholders. Monitor field and laboratory test results. Ensure materials are approved before use on site. Inspect structural, architectural, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP-related works. Non-Conformance and Corrective Actions Issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for non-compliant works or materials. Follow up on Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). Coordinate with site and subcontractor teams to close observations within approved timelines. Identify recurring quality issues and recommend preventive measures. Request rework or corrective action for works that fail to meet approved requirements. Documentation and Reporting Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports. Maintain inspection records, quality logs, material approvals, test reports, technical submittals, and NCR registers. Track inspection outcomes, consultant comments, and corrective-action closures. Prepare quality KPI reports and management summaries. Coordination Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Technical Office, consultants, clients, subcontractors, and approved laboratories. Ensure subcontractors comply with ACSC quality procedures and project requirements. Support project teams in resolving quality issues before they affect project cost, programme, or handover. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or architecture. Minimum 8 years of QA/QC experience in construction projects. Proven experience in villas, residential compounds, multi-storey residential buildings, or similar projects. Strong knowledge of the Saudi Building Code and relevant construction standards. Practical experience in concrete, blockwork, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP inspections. Experience dealing with consultants, clients, subcontractors, and testing laboratories. ISO 9001 Internal Auditor certification is preferred. ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification is an added advantage. Technical Skills Strong ability to read and interpret construction drawings and technical specifications. Experience preparing and reviewing ITPs and Method Statements. Practical experience in NCR and CAPA management. Knowledge of inspection procedures for structural, architectural, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP works. Ability to review material submittals, test reports, and technical approvals. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and AutoCAD. Strong working knowledge of Excel for quality reports and tracking logs. Knowledge of material approval procedures, laboratory testing, and consultant inspection requirements. Familiarity with ERP systems, including Odoo, is preferred. Personal Skills Strong communication and coordination skills. Confident personality with the ability to raise and manage quality issues professionally. Strong reporting, documentation, and analytical skills. High attention to detail. Problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple project priorities. Strong time-management skills. Ideal Candidate Profile Work Experience Experience coordinating inspections with consultants. Experience reviewing material submittals, technical approvals, test reports, and inspection requests. Experience issuing, managing, and closing NCRs, CAPA, and inspection requests. Experience reducing rework and improving first-pass inspection outcomes. Experience preparing weekly and monthly quality reports. Language Proficiency Fluent Arabic communication skills. Good English communication skills, including technical reporting and correspondence. Legal and Regulatory Requirements Must be eligible to work in Saudi Arabia. Methodologies and Frameworks Practical experience preparing and implementing Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs). Practical experience preparing and reviewing Method Statements. Experience with NCR and CAPA processes. Familiarity with ISO 9001 Quality Management System principles. Experience with root-cause analysis and preventive quality actions. Experience maintaining quality records, inspection logs, and project quality documentation. Physical Requirements Able to conduct regular site inspections, walk construction sites, access different work areas, and work in an active construction environment. Availability Available to join within 30 days or less.

1d61c7efcc272183.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شذرات العالمية عن معلم مرحلة متوسطة تربية فنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تدريس طلاب المرحلة المتوسطة في مجال التربية الفنية، وتطوير الخطط الدراسية، وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي للطلاب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد والدروس وطرق التدريس والمحتوى. تدريس طلاب التربية الفنية، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وتكليف الواجبات، وتنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية، وإدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم. تحديد أهداف تعلم واضحة، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها وتصحيحها لتقييم تقدم الطلاب. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى اهتمام إضافي وتحديد الأساليب المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي وإعداد التقارير اللازمة، وحضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التعليم أو التربية الفنية. القدرة على وضع خطط دروس فعالة وتصميم مواد تعليمية مبتكرة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتفاعل مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، حيث يساهم في تنمية قدرات الطلاب الفنية والأكاديمية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة شذرات العالمية، يرجى تقديم طلب التوظيف.

1d43c9d7e8522ebf.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking an experienced Outlet Manager to oversee daily operations for one of its hotel dining outlets in Makkah. 1d53ee4579672982.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة درب لاين عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بمراقبة دوام الموظفين وإدارة الإجازات، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم المتنوعة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة، وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بمهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين كالترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة والمتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التعامل مع الموظفين وحل المشكلات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة كتابياً وشفوياً. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعامل مع المهام المتعددة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمليات الموارد البشرية في شركة درب لاين. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة درب لاين، يرجى تقديم طلبات التوظيف. سيتم التعامل مع جميع الطلبات بمهنية وسرية تامة.

This is a design-and-delivery role, not a design-only role: the Senior Manager is expected to facilitate sessions and coach business leaders directly, not simply commission others to do it. The role also owns training needs analysis (TNA) for the leadership pillar, working directly with business leaders to identify capability gaps rather than relying on a separate analytics function. Depending on the department's operating model it may also directly line manage a small number of reports. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Leadership framework & curriculum design • Design and evolve the leadership development framework and curriculum spanning frontline supervisors through senior leaders. • Translate business priorities and future skills needs into concrete program design decisions, in partnership with the Director. • Build and run interventions using methodologies proven to drive behavioral change, including digital, blended, and experiential formats. • Scan industry shifts, technology, and emerging leadership practices to keep the curriculum current and competitive. Training needs analysis • Own training needs analysis (TNA) for the leadership pillar identifying leadership gaps and future capability requirements directly with business leaders. • Prioritize which capability gaps get addressed first based on business impact and urgency. • Feed TNA findings back into the leadership framework and curriculum roadmap. Personal training delivery & coaching • Personally deliver leadership training sessions across levels stay hands-on in delivery, not only design. • Personally coach business leaders as part of the department's coaching culture. • Structure and scale the internal coaching culture, including coach selection criteria and coaching standards. • Select and manage external facilitators, content providers, and assessment tools when specialist delivery is required. Capability building • Build leadership development capability within HR Business Partners and Line Managers so expertise scales beyond the central team. • Design train-the-trainer approaches so select content can be co-delivered by capable Line Managers. • 8-10+ years in leadership, management, or executive development, with experience designing and personally delivering enterprise-wide interventions in large, complex organizations. • Prior experience owning training needs analysis or capability gap assessments is strongly preferred. Educational qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field. • Master's degree or relevant advanced HR certification (CIPD, ATD, SHRM) preferred. Skills & competencies • Strong facilitation and instructional design skills; comfortable presenting to and influencing senior audiences directly. • Excellent stakeholder management able to extract real needs from business leaders during TNA conversations, not just take requests at face value. • Strong project and budget management skills, with the ability to run multiple programs and vendors in parallel. • Genuine enjoyment of being in the room and delivering this role is not a pure back-office design function. • External market awareness brings outside-in thinking on leadership trends and emerging methodologies.

1d409d92e8ae8617.description: Description: The Director - Geotechnical will oversee all geotechnical and ground investigation activities across the Qiddiya Development which includes leading the execution of the Cliff Stabilisation Roadmap to ensure the long-term stability of the Qiddiya Tuwaiq cliff. This role is responsible for ensuring that geotechnical risks are identified, mitigated, and integrated into planning, design, and delivery activities at a city-wide level. The Director will work across master planning, design, and delivery teams to ensure alignment with Qiddiya’s broader development objectives. City-Wide Geotechnical & Ground Investigation Responsibilities: Establish and lead a city-wide geotechnical and ground investigation strategy that aligns with Qiddiya’s master development plan. Oversee all geotechnical investigations across the city, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and long-term value. Lead the integration of all geotechnical data into Qiddiya’s GIS and digital engineering systems, ensuring long-term asset management and traceability. Oversee procurement and management of city-wide geotechnical consultants and ground investigation contractors. Ensure compliance with international standards, local regulations, and best practices in ground engineering. Coordinate closely with district development teams to ensure geotechnical inputs are embedded in early design decisions and construction methodologies. Implement a geotechnical risk register that informs prioritisation, scope development, and mitigation strategies across the project lifecycle. Support the development of geotechnical specifications, scopes of work, and contract documentation to ensure consistency and technical quality across all works. Cliff Stabilization Responsibilities: Lead strategic planning and execution for the City-wide Cliff Stabilisation project, including the development of a phased delivery strategy that integrates with master planning, construction timelines, and the opening of adjacent districts to the cliff. Progress the project through Qiddiya’s Stage Gate governance framework, leading on the development of all required Stage Gate deliverables. Collaborate with the Delivery Director to design team organisational structures and implement hiring strategies Collaborate with internal teams, including procurement, engineering, digital information, planning, cost planning, commercial & reporting and delivery to deliver the project objectives Coordinate with district master developers to ensure seamless integration of cliff stabilisation solutions with adjacent developments. Develop and maintain a cost plan in collaboration with Qiddiya’s cost planning team and external cost consultants Manage project timelines, budgets, and quality standards across all phases to ensure successful project delivery Define and implement procurement strategies, including the identification and selection of best-fit consultants and contractors to execute the cliff stabilisation works. Act as Scope Owner, contributing to all tender processes, including drafting RFPs, responding to PTCs, evaluating tenders, and responsibility for governance and approvals. Implement risk management frameworks to identify potential risks and integrate mitigation strategies Lead the management of technical and design consultants and oversee the deliverables, ensuring compliance with time, cost, and quality parameters Oversee the review and approval process of the technical and design deliverables, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya’s Cliff Stabilisation Roadmap, engineering best practices and Qiddiya’s approval process. Ensure deliverables are integrated with GIS systems to maintain a comprehensive geotechnical database for Qiddiya’s long-term cliff stability management. Provide support to district developers and asset managers on cliff-related risks. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. Minimum of 12-15 years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or development projects, with specific expertise in geotechnical and stabilisation works. Proven experience in project management, contract administration, and procurement within a complex development environment. Strong leadership, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and external consultants.
